verdict.rationale: HelixDB is a vector-capable database, so tuning index parameters is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only shows that vector index definitions require a dimension and a distance metric. That is a required schema setting, not a documented control for HNSW graph parameters (e.g. M or ef) or for choosing an index type to trade recall against latency and memory. It is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
